Custom docs on NGSolve: finite element setup

This document attempts to show how ngsolve sets up finite elements.

class ngsolve.Mesh

NGSolve interface to the Netgen mesh. Provides access and functionality to use the mesh for finite element calculations.

Parameters:

mesh (netgen.Mesh): a mesh generated from Netgen

property dim

mesh dimension

property ne

number of volume elements

property nv

number of vertices
